name: Admin Accounting Ads Log
description: Superuser tracks advertising spend at /panel/accounting/ads: chronological list with a computed running accumulated column (calculated over the full history), origin-card and platform filters, saved filter tabs (accounting_ads view with seeded defaults) and modal CRUD; the leading three-dots menu of each row offers Detalle e historial, Ver nota when the record has a note, Editar and Eliminar with confirmation.
